svg.title: My ninja way
svg.desc: Hunter stands back to back with Naruto beside three things they build: living interfaces, motion with a story arc, and enterprise-grade data flows.

g.text: Special Grade Sorcerer by day, limitless architect by night.
Magnetic, pixel-perfect user experiences in React, Next.js & TypeScript
Zero-vulnerability shields, strict validations & resilient backend systems
Colliding high-performance frontends and scalable APIs at the speed of light
“Nah, I'd ship. In this domain, infinite creativity flows freely.”
